content.short: Monad is an ultra-high-performance, EVM-compatible L1 blockchain featuring parallel execution and targeting 10,000 TPS.
content.description: Monad is an ultra-high-performance, Layer 1 blockchain designed to provide the speed and scalability needed for the next generation of decentralized applications while maintaining full EVM compatibility. Unlike traditional sequential processors, Monad utilizes parallel execution to process multiple transactions simultaneously, targeting a throughput of 10,000 transactions per second with sub-second finality. This allows developers to port existing Ethereum dApps to Monad with zero code modifications while benefiting from significantly higher performance. The network introduces several technical innovations, including MonadDb and the MonadBFT consensus mechanism.
